messages:
Maya Rao: Quick check — weekly capacity review. Focus: cross-region fallback readiness and APAC burst hours. Can we confirm numbers and any network throttling risks?
Akshay Patel: pulling numbers now, will paste a short table. should be quick.
ops-bot: capacity-report v2.4 generated — snapshot attached.
Akshay Patel:```
region     reserved_gpu_h   forecast_gpu_h   delta
us-east-1  120000           110000           -10000
us-west-2  80000            90000            +10000
eu-west-1  60000            65000            +5000
ap-southeast-1 15000        27000            +12000
```
Akshay Patel: TL;DR — APAC demand spike looks real (promo + new customer). We'll need ~12k extra GPUh this week if traffic holds.
Lina Gomez: Network note: we saw intermittent 3–6s spikes between ap-southeast-1 and us-east-1 during the internal failover runs yesterday. Not full outage but could impact cold-starts for large contexts.
Sam Cho: Cost/ops question — if we route APAC fallback to us-west-2 instead of us-east-1, what is the expected latency change and dollar delta?
Akshay Patel: Rough numbers: routing to us-west-2 adds ~30–60ms p50, p95 up by ~120ms for APAC clients, but reduces cross-Pacific egress e.g., ~15% lower networking cost vs us-east-1 in our current topology.
Maya Rao: Action items: 1) Lina to validate failover network path and run traceroutes during peak window, 2) Akshay to provision a 14k GPUh burst in ap-southeast-1 (spot + reserved mix) and add a temporary routing policy, 3) Sam to estimate cost hit and prepare a one-slide for leadership. Can everyone ack? :white_check_mark:
Lina Gomez: Ack — will run path-sensitive tests at 2200 UTC and post results.
Akshay Patel: Ack — firing provisioning request, ETA 45m for capacity pool warm-up. Will post command and job id.
ops-bot: provisioning-job 45981 accepted — pool warm-up started. ETA 42m.
Sam Cho: Ack — will prepare cost slide, expecting ~6–8% uplift in weekly infra spend if APAC traffic stays at forecast.
Maya Rao: Thanks. If any network spikes >5s during the tests, tag me and we'll cut a temporary canary to us-west-2 earlier. Otherwise we'll reconvene Friday 1500 UTC for final numbers. :calendar:
